Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I'll keep it between us. I won't pass the Albany plan or the Bluefin codename to Ruth or anyone else, and I won't mention it in any channel.

Since Ruth hasn't been briefed, the right route is probably you or Mateo bringing her in directly. If it would help, I can set up time on her calendar or draft a note to her for you to review. I won't send anything to her about Bluefin unless you ask me to write it and you approve the wording.
